nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

## Character Replacement wiring
- **Load Source Video** feeds `<Video 1>` (motion/camera/action) and its audio.
- The **first frame** of that source video feeds `<Picture 1>`.
- **Load Character Reference** feeds `<Picture 2>`.
- The prompt is prefilled to tell H3 to preserve the source video's motion/scene while replacing the main character with `<Picture 2>`.

Requires **ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite** for `VHS_LoadVideo`.

## Turbo Character Replacement — simplified
- `<Picture 1>` = replacement character only.
- `<Video 1>` = source motion, camera, timing and scene.
- The automatic first-frame reference was removed to avoid identity mixing and the Turbo 3-vs-2 tensor mismatch seen with 2 images + 1 video.
- Turbo LoRA strength: **0.8**.
- Dedicated MiniMax H3 Turbo Sampler + **8 steps**.

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   └── 📂 text_encoders/
│       └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: Prompt - FULL Character Replacement (Turbo)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Chisa from <Picture 1>, a slender anime girl with long straight black hair accented by red ribbon bows, striking crimson eyes, a black cropped sailor-style uniform with slashed laced sleeves, a red neckerchief, a black pleated miniskirt, thigh strap, knee-high dark socks, black loafers, and a massive red crystalline mechanical greatsword with glowing energy conduits.
<Subject 2> is the colossal crystalline beast in <Picture 2>, composed of sharp jagged obsidian armor plates with pulsating crimson energy fissures and a floating glowing red halo behind its spiked carapace.
<Picture 2> is the first frame of [Shot 1], establishing <Subject 1> descending from mid-air with her raised greatsword toward <Subject 2> in a ruined gothic cathedral courtyard under a massive blood moon.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The 15-second high-intensity anime battle sequence begins from <Picture 2>, depicting a dynamic back-and-forth clash between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> across the shattered gothic plaza, culminating in a decisive slash and a stylish hero finish by <Subject 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6], [Shot 7]): fully_preserved - Chisa's facial design, hairstyle, red ribbon accessories, sailor-punk outfit, and red mechanical greatsword are strictly preserved across all shots.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - the beast's jagged dark crystal body, radiating red fissures, and red ring halo are consistently maintained.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - used as the concrete initial frame anchoring the opening downward strike.

detailed_description:
The video is rendered in a premium 2D anime action style with crisp linework, vibrant crimson-and-black contrast, dynamic camera tracking, and graphic anime music-video pacing.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 2>. <Subject 1> hurtles downward through the air, bringing her glowing red greatsword down with devastating force. <Subject 2> roars and raises its massive obsidian forearm claw to parry. A high-speed downward camera tilt follows the descent until the blade violently collides with the crystal arm, unleashing a burst of blinding crimson shockwaves and scattering fractured pavement.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, a dynamic low-angle tracking shot captures <Subject 2> swinging its spiked tail across the courtyard. The colossal sweep smashes stone pillars. <Subject 1> executes a fluid backflip over the sweeping tail, her pleated skirt and twin-tail ribbons fluttering cleanly through the frame, evading the crushing blow by inches.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a medium profile tracking shot moving rapidly sideways. <Subject 1> touches down, immediately accelerating into a sprint along the crumbling flagstones. <Subject 2> unleashes multiple crimson laser projectiles from its crystalline back spikes. <Subject 1> weaves through the explosions with precise zigzag steps, deflecting incoming energy spikes with sharp deflections of her red blade.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.000, an over-the-shoulder medium-close shot frames <Subject 2> lunging forward with jaws agape. <Subject 1> slides underneath the lunging behemoth along the polished floor. Looking up with a fierce, focused crimson gaze, she slashes her greatsword upward against the beast's exposed underbelly, sending jagged shards of black armor flying into the air.
[Shot 5] At 00:09.500, an orbiting whip-pan shot circles around <Subject 1> as she vaults off a fallen gothic archway high into the air. The camera rotates dynamically from a low angle upward, framing her against the gigantic crimson moon. The mechanical gears in her greatsword spin rapidly, causing the crystalline edge to flare with brilliant crimson luminescence.
[Shot 6] At 00:11.800, a high-speed Dutch-angle push-in shot captures <Subject 1> executing a blinding cross-slash mid-descent. A graphic calligraphic slash of red energy bisects <Subject 2>'s glowing core. The monster freezes in mid-roar as massive fracture lines spread across its body, detonating in a clean burst of dark smoke and dissolving red embers.
[Shot 7] At 00:13.200, the camera cuts to a grounded low-angle fashion hero shot smoothly dollying forward. <Subject 1> lands effortlessly on one heel, flicking her greatsword with a swift one-handed arc to rest it against her shoulder. Floating red petals and glowing embers drift across the foreground. She glances back over her shoulder toward the camera with a calm, confident expression, her black hair and red ribbons settling gently in the breeze until 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous atmospheric night wind, howling gusts around gothic spires, the heavy thud of shattering stone pillars, metallic sword parries, roaring shockwaves, crystalline armor crumbling, and the crisp click of leather boots on polished stone.

non_diegetic_music:
Fast-paced Japanese electro-punk track featuring driving 165 BPM distorted bass guitar, aggressive synthesizer leads, rapid breakbeats, and explosive rhythmic drops synchronized with blade impacts, resolving into a lingering electronic pulse for the final hero pose.
